children: HEINEKEN HOLDING N.V. REPORTS ON 2026 THIRD QUARTER TRADING
Volume and revenue growth across all regions
Heineken Holding N.V. engages in no activities other than its participating interest in Heineken N.V. and the management or supervision of and provision of services to that company.

Unless stated otherwise, all comments and figures in this announcement refer to BEIA metrics, and growth % indicates organic growth. Throughout this report figures refer to quarterly performance unless otherwise indicated.
Growth: continued momentum, all regions contributing
Total volume grew 4.8% (YTD: 2.7%), with consolidated volume 3.9% (YTD: 1.6%), licensed volume 19.5% (YTD: 21.8%).
Net revenue grew 4.6% (YTD: 3.4%), net revenue per hectolitre up 0.7% (YTD: 1.7%).
Price-mix on a constant geographic basis up 1.8% (YTD: 2.4%).
Gained or held share in more than two-thirds of HEINEKEN's markets.
Segments and Brands: priority segments and global brands driving growth
Premium volume grew 11.5%, significantly ahead of the total portfolio.
Global brands volume grew 9.9% (YTD: 6.9%), with all five brands in growth, and Heineken® up 9.7% (YTD: 6.8%).
Mainstream volume increased 2.4% (YTD: 0.3%), with HEINEKEN's local power brands outperforming.
Low & no-alcohol grew in the double-digits, led by Heineken® 0.0 and Heineken® Ultimate.
Beyond beer volume grew in the mid teens, supported by Desperados innovations.
Regional performance: all four regions in volume and revenue growth
Africa & Middle East: sustained resilient growth.
Americas: returned to growth on easier comparison base.
Europe: volume growth and strong summer execution on softer comparatives.
Progressing with pace on EverGreen 2030 priorities
Accelerated innovation, including Heineken® Ultimate 3.5%, Desperados Sunlight, and Tiger Smooth.
Agreed to acquire a majority stake in Stëlz, subject to regulatory approval, to strengthen HEINEKEN's beyond beer portfolio.
Productivity programme on track to deliver €500m gross savings for the full-year.
Scaling HEINEKEN's simplified European operating model following successful pilots.
Reiterating HEINEKEN's 2% to 6% organic operating profit growth guidance for 2026.

HEINEKEN will host an analyst and investor conference call with Harold van den Broek, Chief Financial Officer of Heineken N.V., in relation to its Third Quarter 2026 Trading Update today at 10:00 CET/09:00 GMT.
